title: 配水管網壓力管理
subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection
summary: 本課從高程與服務壓力出發，分析壓力相依需求、漏失指數及閥門耗能，再進入閥權度、遠端延遲、回授方向和備援供水。最後把快速水錘與低流量水質納入同一管理問題，讓節水效益與服務可靠度各有證據，不把降低平均壓力當成唯一成功指標。
summaryEn: Beginning with elevation and service pressure, this course examines pressure-dependent demand, leakage exponents and valve dissipation, then addresses authority, remote delay, feedback direction and backup supply. Rapid transients and low-flow water quality complete the management problem, giving savings and service reliability separate evidence instead of treating lower average pressure as the only success metric.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證」與「壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification" and "Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高程水頭與服務壓力」如何影響配水管網壓力管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elevation head and service pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pressure management of water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壓力管理要控制的是用戶與關鍵設施可取得的壓力，不能只追求減壓閥出口的一個數字。節點水頭包含高程與壓力，沿途摩阻又隨需求變動，因此低處壓力過高時，高處仍可能接近供水不足；管理分區需同時考慮高程帶、管路阻力與代表性服務點。下式分開能量水頭、高程及流動損失，忽略速度水頭差；所得壓力水頭只適用指定需求工況，不代表全天最小值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高程水頭與服務壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure management concerns pressure available to customers and critical facilities, not merely one number at a reducing-valve outlet. Nodal head includes elevation and pressure, while friction changes with demand. A low-lying area can have excessive pressure while an elevated area approaches insufficient supply, so zoning must consider elevation bands, resistance and representative service points together. The relation separates energy head, elevation and losses while neglecting velocity-head differences. The resulting pressure head applies to one demand condition, not the daily minimum. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Elevation head and service pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設供水水頭H=100 m、節點高程z=60 m、路徑損失hf=15 m，壓力水頭h=H−z−hf=25 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume supply head H=100 m, node elevation z=60 m and path loss hf=15 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「減壓閥出口壓力足夠就能保證所有用戶壓力都足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate reducing-valve outlet pressure guarantees adequate pressure for every customer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高程水頭與服務壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Elevation head and service pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 壓力管理要控制的是用戶與關鍵設施可取得的壓力，不能只追求減壓閥出口的一個數字。節點水頭包含高程與壓力，沿途摩阻又隨需求變動，因此低處壓力過高時，高處仍可能接近供水不足；管理分區需同時考慮高程帶、管路阻力與代表性服務點。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure management concerns pressure available to customers and critical facilities, not merely one number at a reducing-valve outlet. Nodal head includes elevation and pressure, while friction changes with demand.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：減壓閥出口壓力足夠就能保證所有用戶壓力都足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate reducing-valve outlet pressure guarantees adequate pressure for every customer. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 減壓閥出口壓力足夠就能保證所有用戶壓力都足夠。
壓力管理要控制的是用戶與關鍵設施可取得的壓力，不能只追求減壓閥出口的一個數字。
管網模型能收斂就表示每一節點都實際得到要求水量。
optionsEn: Adequate reducing-valve outlet pressure guarantees adequate pressure for every customer.
Pressure management concerns pressure available to customers and critical facilities, not merely one number at a reducing-valve outlet.
A converged network model means every node actually receives its required flow.
quiz.explanation: 壓力管理要控制的是用戶與關鍵設施可取得的壓力，不能只追求減壓閥出口的一個數字。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure management concerns pressure available to customers and critical facilities, not merely one number at a reducing-valve outlet. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高程水頭與服務壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elevation head and service pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設供水水頭H=100 m、節點高程z=60 m、路徑損失hf=15 m，壓力水頭h=H−z−hf=25 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume supply head H=100 m, node elevation z=60 m and path loss hf=15 m. Pressure head h=H−z−hf=25 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將關鍵服務點的高程、壓力與需求時間對齊，核對感測器讀值是表壓或水頭。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align elevations, pressure and demand times at critical service points, checking whether sensors report gauge pressure or head.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設供水水頭H=100 m、節點高程z=60 m、路徑損失hf=15 m，壓力水頭h=H−z−hf=25 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume supply head H=100 m, node elevation z=60 m and path loss hf=15 m. Pressure head h=H−z−hf=25 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 減壓閥降低的水力功率都已自動轉換成可使用電力。
通訊連線正常就表示控制器讀到的壓力一定是即時值。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設供水水頭H=100 m、節點高程z=60 m、路徑損失hf=15 m，壓力水頭h=H−z−hf=25 m。
optionsEn: All hydraulic power removed by a reducing valve automatically becomes usable electricity.
A working communication link guarantees the controller sees current pressure.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume supply head H=100 m, node elevation z=60 m and path loss hf=15 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設供水水頭H=100 m、節點高程z=60 m、路徑損失hf=15 m，壓力水頭h=H−z−hf=25 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume supply head H=100 m, node elevation z=60 m and path loss hf=15 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高程水頭與服務壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Elevation head and service pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將關鍵服務點的高程、壓力與需求時間對齊，核對感測器讀值是表壓或水頭。比較尖峰與低需求兩個時段的水頭線，檢查閥後量測是否能代表最不利用戶而非只代表附近低點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align elevations, pressure and demand times at critical service points, checking whether sensors report gauge pressure or head. Compare hydraulic grades at peak and low demand and test whether the downstream sensor represents the limiting customer rather than a nearby low point. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：繪出高低兩個服務點在相同閥後水頭下的壓力差，加入需求增加造成的摩阻。列出應監測的最不利位置，避免只以平均區壓決定管理策略。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw pressures at high and low service points under one valve-outlet head and add demand-dependent friction. Identify limiting monitoring locations instead of selecting management strategy from average district pressure alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只在減壓閥附近量到足夠壓力，可能漏掉遠端或高處缺壓；若把地面高程錯當管線量測基準，模型又會把壓力不足誤判成儀器偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adequate pressure near a reducing valve can conceal shortages at remote or elevated users. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將關鍵服務點的高程、壓力與需求時間對齊，核對感測器讀值是表壓或水頭。比較尖峰與低需求兩個時段的水頭線，檢查閥後量測是否能代表最不利用戶而非只代表附近低點。
knowledge.textEn: Align elevations, pressure and demand times at critical service points, checking whether sensors report gauge pressure or head. Compare hydraulic grades at peak and low demand and test whether the downstream sensor represents the limiting customer rather than a nearby low point.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 繪出高低兩個服務點在相同閥後水頭下的壓力差，加入需求增加造成的摩阻。列出應監測的最不利位置，避免只以平均區壓決定管理策略。
knowledge.textEn: Draw pressures at high and low service points under one valve-outlet head and add demand-dependent friction. Identify limiting monitoring locations instead of selecting management strategy from average district pressure alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification"?
options: 將關鍵服務點的高程、壓力與需求時間對齊，核對感測器讀值是表壓或水頭。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
現場有旁通管就代表任何失效情境都能維持原有供水。
optionsEn: Align elevations, pressure and demand times at critical service points, checking whether sensors report gauge pressure or head.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Having a bypass guarantees unchanged supply in every failure scenario.
quiz.explanation: 將關鍵服務點的高程、壓力與需求時間對齊，核對感測器讀值是表壓或水頭。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align elevations, pressure and demand times at critical service points, checking whether sensors report gauge pressure or head. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高程水頭與服務壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Elevation head and service pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只在減壓閥附近量到足夠壓力，可能漏掉遠端或高處缺壓；若把地面高程錯當管線量測基準，模型又會把壓力不足誤判成儀器偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adequate pressure near a reducing valve can conceal shortages at remote or elevated users. Confusing ground elevation with the pressure-measurement datum can then misclassify a genuine pressure deficit as instrument error. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：下式分開能量水頭、高程及流動損失，忽略速度水頭差；所得壓力水頭只適用指定需求工況，不代表全天最小值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The resulting pressure head applies to one demand condition, not the daily minimum.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「減壓閥出口壓力足夠就能保證所有用戶壓力都足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate reducing-valve outlet pressure guarantees adequate pressure for every customer." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只在減壓閥附近量到足夠壓力，可能漏掉遠端或高處缺壓；若把地面高程錯當管線量測基準，模型又會把壓力不足誤判成儀器偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Adequate pressure near a reducing valve can conceal shortages at remote or elevated users. Confusing ground elevation with the pressure-measurement datum can then misclassify a genuine pressure deficit as instrument error.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只在減壓閥附近量到足夠壓力，可能漏掉遠端或高處缺壓；若把地面高程錯當管線量測基準，模型又會把壓力不足誤判成儀器偏差。
管網模型能收斂就表示每一節點都實際得到要求水量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Adequate pressure near a reducing valve can conceal shortages at remote or elevated users.
A converged network model means every node actually receives its required flow.
quiz.explanation: 只在減壓閥附近量到足夠壓力，可能漏掉遠端或高處缺壓；若把地面高程錯當管線量測基準，模型又會把壓力不足誤判成儀器偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adequate pressure near a reducing valve can conceal shortages at remote or elevated users. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力相依需求與缺水量」如何影響配水管網壓力管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure-dependent demand and deficit” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pressure management of water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 傳統固定需求模型可能在壓力不足時仍要求節點供出全部流量，造成不合理的負壓結果。壓力相依需求把可供流量連到可用壓力區間，使缺水成為可量化輸出；但需求曲線仍是模型假設，不能將所有用戶、儲水設備與消防用途視為相同的孔口行為。此例採分段模型：低於最低水頭供量為零，達要求水頭供滿量，中間以平方根插值；參數不是任何地方服務標準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力相依需求與缺水量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fixed-demand model can require full delivery even when pressure is insufficient, producing unrealistic negative pressures. Pressure-dependent demand relates available flow to a pressure range and makes supply deficit an explicit output. The demand curve remains an assumption, however, and customers, storage installations and fire-service functions cannot all be treated as identical orifices. The example sets zero delivery below minimum head, full delivery at required head and square-root interpolation between them. Its parameters are not jurisdictional service standards. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure-dependent demand and deficit” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設需求qreq=20 L/s、hmin=10 m、hreq=30 m、實際h=20 m，q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume required demand qreq=20 L/s, hmin=10 m, hreq=30 m and actual h=20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管網模型能收斂就表示每一節點都實際得到要求水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A converged network model means every node actually receives its required flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力相依需求與缺水量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure-dependent demand and deficit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 傳統固定需求模型可能在壓力不足時仍要求節點供出全部流量，造成不合理的負壓結果。壓力相依需求把可供流量連到可用壓力區間，使缺水成為可量化輸出；但需求曲線仍是模型假設，不能將所有用戶、儲水設備與消防用途視為相同的孔口行為。
knowledge.textEn: A fixed-demand model can require full delivery even when pressure is insufficient, producing unrealistic negative pressures. Pressure-dependent demand relates available flow to a pressure range and makes supply deficit an explicit output.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：管網模型能收斂就表示每一節點都實際得到要求水量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A converged network model means every node actually receives its required flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 管網模型能收斂就表示每一節點都實際得到要求水量。
漏失壓力指數固定不變且能直接預測未來所有爆管。
傳統固定需求模型可能在壓力不足時仍要求節點供出全部流量，造成不合理的負壓結果。
optionsEn: A converged network model means every node actually receives its required flow.
The leakage exponent is fixed and directly predicts every future pipe break.
A fixed-demand model can require full delivery even when pressure is insufficient, producing unrealistic negative pressures.
quiz.explanation: 傳統固定需求模型可能在壓力不足時仍要求節點供出全部流量，造成不合理的負壓結果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A fixed-demand model can require full delivery even when pressure is insufficient, producing unrealistic negative pressures. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力相依需求與缺水量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure-dependent demand and deficit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設需求qreq=20 L/s、hmin=10 m、hreq=30 m、實際h=20 m，q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume required demand qreq=20 L/s, hmin=10 m, hreq=30 m and actual h=20 m. Delivered q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較固定需求與壓力相依模型在相同邊界下的供量與低壓分布，查核用戶類別與儲水設備是否需不同描述。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare fixed and pressure-dependent demand models under identical boundaries, examining delivery and low-pressure distribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設需求qreq=20 L/s、hmin=10 m、hreq=30 m、實際h=20 m，q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume required demand qreq=20 L/s, hmin=10 m, hreq=30 m and actual h=20 m. Delivered q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設需求qreq=20 L/s、hmin=10 m、hreq=30 m、實際h=20 m，q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s。
控制閥只要能通過最大流量就一定能穩定調節所有流量。
比例增益越大就一定越快達標且不會增加振盪。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume required demand qreq=20 L/s, hmin=10 m, hreq=30 m and actual h=20 m.
A valve that passes maximum flow can stably regulate every lower flow.
Larger proportional gain always reaches the target faster without increasing oscillation.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設需求qreq=20 L/s、hmin=10 m、hreq=30 m、實際h=20 m，q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume required demand qreq=20 L/s, hmin=10 m, hreq=30 m and actual h=20 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓力相依需求與缺水量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure-dependent demand and deficit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較固定需求與壓力相依模型在相同邊界下的供量與低壓分布，查核用戶類別與儲水設備是否需不同描述。用可取得的壓力及服務資料驗證缺水量，不只要求數值迭代收斂。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare fixed and pressure-dependent demand models under identical boundaries, examining delivery and low-pressure distribution. Check whether customer categories and storage installations need different representations, and validate deficits using available pressure and service data rather than accepting numerical convergence alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以三個水頭值跨越最低與要求界線，檢查分段需求是否連續且不超過滿額需求。再說明哪些用戶資料可支持參數，而哪些仍應保留敏感度範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Evaluate three heads spanning minimum and required limits, checking continuity and the full-demand cap. Explain which customer observations support the parameters and which uncertainties should remain as sensitivity ranges.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以固定需求強迫缺壓節點繼續滿額供水會低估服務中斷，反之把假設需求曲線當精確行為也會製造過度確定的缺水預測；兩者都可能錯排優先改善區。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Forcing full demand at a pressure-deficient node understates service disruption, while treating an assumed demand curve as exact behavior creates false certainty in deficit estimates. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較固定需求與壓力相依模型在相同邊界下的供量與低壓分布，查核用戶類別與儲水設備是否需不同描述。用可取得的壓力及服務資料驗證缺水量，不只要求數值迭代收斂。
knowledge.textEn: Compare fixed and pressure-dependent demand models under identical boundaries, examining delivery and low-pressure distribution. Check whether customer categories and storage installations need different representations, and validate deficits using available pressure and service data rather than accepting numerical convergence alone.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以三個水頭值跨越最低與要求界線，檢查分段需求是否連續且不超過滿額需求。再說明哪些用戶資料可支持參數，而哪些仍應保留敏感度範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Evaluate three heads spanning minimum and required limits, checking continuity and the full-demand cap. Explain which customer observations support the parameters and which uncertainties should remain as sensitivity ranges.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較固定需求與壓力相依模型在相同邊界下的供量與低壓分布，查核用戶類別與儲水設備是否需不同描述。
平均壓力降低後就不需要再檢查任何快速水錘事件。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Compare fixed and pressure-dependent demand models under identical boundaries, examining delivery and low-pressure distribution.
Lower average pressure removes the need to examine rapid transients.
quiz.explanation: 比較固定需求與壓力相依模型在相同邊界下的供量與低壓分布，查核用戶類別與儲水設備是否需不同描述。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare fixed and pressure-dependent demand models under identical boundaries, examining delivery and low-pressure distribution. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓力相依需求與缺水量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure-dependent demand and deficit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以固定需求強迫缺壓節點繼續滿額供水會低估服務中斷，反之把假設需求曲線當精確行為也會製造過度確定的缺水預測；兩者都可能錯排優先改善區。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Forcing full demand at a pressure-deficient node understates service disruption, while treating an assumed demand curve as exact behavior creates false certainty in deficit estimates. Both can misdirect improvement priorities. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此例採分段模型：低於最低水頭供量為零，達要求水頭供滿量，中間以平方根插值；參數不是任何地方服務標準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Its parameters are not jurisdictional service standards.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管網模型能收斂就表示每一節點都實際得到要求水量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A converged network model means every node actually receives its required flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以固定需求強迫缺壓節點繼續滿額供水會低估服務中斷，反之把假設需求曲線當精確行為也會製造過度確定的缺水預測；兩者都可能錯排優先改善區。
knowledge.textEn: Forcing full demand at a pressure-deficient node understates service disruption, while treating an assumed demand curve as exact behavior creates false certainty in deficit estimates. Both can misdirect improvement priorities.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
漏失壓力指數固定不變且能直接預測未來所有爆管。
以固定需求強迫缺壓節點繼續滿額供水會低估服務中斷，反之把假設需求曲線當精確行為也會製造過度確定的缺水預測；兩者都可能錯排優先改善區。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The leakage exponent is fixed and directly predicts every future pipe break.
Forcing full demand at a pressure-deficient node understates service disruption, while treating an assumed demand curve as exact behavior creates false certainty in deficit estimates.
quiz.explanation: 以固定需求強迫缺壓節點繼續滿額供水會低估服務中斷，反之把假設需求曲線當精確行為也會製造過度確定的缺水預測；兩者都可能錯排優先改善區。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Forcing full demand at a pressure-deficient node understates service disruption, while treating an assumed demand curve as exact behavior creates false certainty in deficit estimates. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
